To increase its market presence in emerging markets, it created an intranet that the sales staff could access to access information on the company product and their order status. It used a ‘Push Approach’ to electronically send news, sales reports, and customer information to the sales staff and its management. It also created an extranet distributors and channel partners and a website for design engineers who use its components in electronic and telecommunications products. This website contains information of more than 30,000 products in the PDF format. To give far-flung engineers reasonable download speed the company entered into an outsourced arrangement with XYZ Inc. XYZ Inc. has data centers around the globe and offers hosting and other Internet infrastructure services. ABC Inc has a sales of $2 billion and employs more than 10,000 people around the globe.
